text:
Maya (VP Eng): thanks for the great all-hands — dropping an open thread for follow-ups on runtime/batching/kernel asks. post short questions and we'll track actions :raised_hands:
Ryan (Staff SWE): quick q — what's the priority between improving microsecond tail latency vs increasing batching for cost?
Maya (VP Eng): our SLOs still prioritize p95/p99 tail latency for interactive routes; batching improvements should be scoped to background/async workloads first.
Sophia (Runtime PM): to add — we're proposing a split policy: interactive routes get small batch windows + prewarm, async gets aggressive batching. will post RFC link.
Tariq (Infra Eng): can we get explicit numbers for "small batch window"? 5ms, 10ms? need for autoscaler tuning.
Sophia (Runtime PM): target: interactive <= 8ms window, async up to 50ms. those are starting points — open to perf feedback.
Lee (ML Eng): kernel work note — some attention kernels are ~25% faster on A100 for long seqs; need to validate on our quantized path. anyone owning bench matrix?
Ryan (Staff SWE): I can take bench matrix for quantized kernels — will need sample traces and seq-length distribution.
Maya (VP Eng): assign Ryan to kernel benching for quantized fast-paths. Ryan, sync with Lee on model list.
Ryan (Staff SWE): ack. @Lee can you drop the model shortlist here?
Lee (ML Eng): shortlist: declio-7b, redwood-instruct-3b, llama-2-13b. will add expected seq distributions for chat vs batch.
Tariq (Infra Eng): related ops question — KV cache memory pressure on the Dedicated pools spiked during last canary. is that a config we can change without infra churn?
Sophia (Runtime PM): action: ops-config tweak to cap per-connection KV cache at 12GB for Dedicated canaries. I'll open the config PR.
Maya (VP Eng): also want a rollback plan if the cap causes latency regressions. canary policy should auto-fallback to smaller model variant.
Ryan (Staff SWE): noting complexity: some models don't have smaller variants. fallback path needs to consider model compatibility.
Lee (ML Eng): we could compile a lightweight distil variant for fallback — but that's nontrivial. maybe prefer cross-variant routing to a cheaper config.
Tariq (Infra Eng): DeployBot: canary from hostpool-3 succeeded 6/3 14:22 UTC :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: canary metrics: p95 +1.2ms, error rate stable.
Sophia (Runtime PM): thanks DeployBot. can we add a dedicated dashboard tile for KV eviction rates? Ops asked for it.
Maya (VP Eng): yes — telemetry OWNER: @Tariq, dashboard ticket in GA.
Tariq (Infra Eng): creating ticket now, will link it here.
Ryan (Staff SWE): on batching algorithm — are we keeping continuous batching or switching to time-sliced windows?
Lee (ML Eng): runtime microbench shows continuous batching better for throughput but can spike latency under bursty traffic. hybrid looks promising: continuous with a max wait threshold.
Sophia (Runtime PM): hybrid = continuous + global max wait (8ms interactive) + per-tenant burst cap. adding to roadmap as "hybrid-batching-v1".
Maya (VP Eng): deadline for hybrid PoC: end of next sprint (2 weeks). Owners: Ryan + Tariq + Lee.
Ryan (Staff SWE): putting up a quick spike branch today. will post link.
Lee (ML Eng): I'll help add kernel hooks to expose batch sizes for telemetry.
Sophia (Runtime PM): small ask from product teams: better signal for quality regressions tied to batching/quantization. want evals on canary results.
Maya (VP Eng): Redwood Optimize team should wire auto-evals into canaries. @Lee and @Sophia to coordinate with Optimize.
Lee (ML Eng): will reach out to Optimize leads.
Tariq (Infra Eng): ops note — prewarm VM image size impacts cold start; smaller runtime image reduces cold start by ~200ms. proposing an image-minify task.
Maya (VP Eng): approved. add as infra chore.
Sophia (Runtime PM): I'll compile action list and owners after this thread and post in the roadmap doc: https://go.redwood/runtime-roadmap (internal)
Ryan (Staff SWE): one last question — do we plan to expose per-route batching configs in the Console? would help product teams tune.
Maya (VP Eng): yes — Console support is on the Q2 plan. UX/controls will be coarse-grained initially.
Sophia (Runtime PM): follow-up: I'll run a short survey to pick top 10 routes for initial per-route rollout.
Maya (VP Eng): awesome. thanks everyone. closing the thread in 48h unless new blockers show up. :sparkles:
Ryan (Staff SWE): noted, will post branch link.
Tariq (Infra Eng): ticket for dashboard: #RD-4823
DeployBot: archived channel logs for canary run 2387654300
Sophia (Runtime PM): updated roadmap doc with action items: owners + due dates. link above.
Maya (VP Eng): passing to Eng leads to drive. :clap:
